scheme_name: Overseas Scholarships For Scheduled Tribes-Madhya Pradesh
other_conditions: Only one child of a parent will be eligible for the scholarship, and only once.
For post‑graduation, applicants must have passed their graduation degree or its equivalent with at least 55% marks in second class.
Applicants are not eligible for the scholarship for an equivalent postgraduate degree.
For PhD, applicants must have completed a Master’s degree with at least 50% marks and have 2 years of teaching/research or an M.Phil.
